extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from XML/PDF/OA package locators; mechanism claims are bounded to assays directly present in local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: S2 shows rapid phenotypic killing of S. aureus ATCC 29213 at MIC and 2x MIC in time-kill assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Time-kill evidence supports bactericidal activity but does not identify a molecular target by itself.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: S2 binds S. aureus lipoteichoic acid in the BODIPY-TR cadaverine displacement assay more strongly than S1/S3 in the reported comparison.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S2 interaction with Staphylococcus aureus LTA
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay supports LTA binding context; it does not prove LTA is the only in vivo target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: S2 perturbs S. aureus membrane potential, increases propidium iodide uptake, and produces SEM/TEM-visible membrane damage.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S2 against Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 29213 membranes
mechanism_claims.limitations: Membrane disruption is source-supported; no intracellular protein/nucleic-acid target is established.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: S2 reduces S. aureus skin-infection burden and inflammatory readouts in the murine subcutaneous infection model.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S2 in murine Staphylococcus aureus subcutaneous infection model

source_locators.locator: xml:sec=34:Inhibition of Pro-inflammatory Cytokines and Stimulation of Anti-inflammatory Cytokines

mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo efficacy and cytokine changes are phenotype/host-response evidence, not a standalone molecular mechanism.
